prescribedGeometry.description: Exact A2 prescribed display paths with equal binary geometry, equal frequency, common circulation, 120-degree phases, and cyclic path equivalence.

choices: The flattening coordinate lambda_A=0 selects the mutually orthogonal near-rest endpoint, with binary orbit planes yz, xz, and xy in the declared relative frame.
The common radius R=0.32, axial half-separation h=0.12, transverse orbit radius rho=sqrt(R^2-h^2), and frequency f=0.25 are prescribed display choices.
Phase-compensated cyclic frames make the declared 120-degree rotation permute the complete endpoint paths.
Normalized linear axis interpolation defines the wider taxonomy path but does not alter this near-rest representative.
